title: ConfigResult
description: Result of `rebar config --output json`. It contains the resolved typed configuration, the source layer that supplied each value, and the discovered project and user configuration files. `project_config` is null when no project configuration exists. `precedence` lists layers from lowest to highest priority. Secret values are not part of the typed configuration. Configuration errors exit 1 and emit no JSON.

config.description: Resolved core configuration, keyed by section and field.

sources.description: Winning source layer for every value in `config`, with the same section and field structure.

project_config.description: Discovered project configuration file, or null when none exists.

user_config.description: User configuration path and whether that file exists.

precedence.description: Configuration layers from lowest to highest priority. The order is default, user, project, env, and cli.
